title: Similar Adjacent Subarrays
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

You are given a sequence of positive integers $A=(A_1,A_2,\dots,A_N)$ of length $N$.

Find the number of triples of integers $(a,b,c)$ that satisfy all of the following conditions.

- $0 \leq a \lt b \lt c \leq N$
- $b-a=c-b$
- There is exactly one integer $i$ between $1$ and $b-a$, inclusive, such that $A_{a+i} \neq A_{b+i}$.

## Constraints

- $2 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5$
- $1 \leq A_i \leq 10^9$
- All input values are integers.

## Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

$N$\
$A_1$ $A_2$ $\ldots$ $A_N$

## Output

Print the answer in one line.
